research_question: Can a multi-layer physical resource envelope make upper-limit claims for useful computational throughput comparable and falsifiable?
hard_invariants: State workload, correctness, reliability, and wall-clock boundary.
Separate device-transition, communication, thermodynamic, thermal, memory, I/O, and logical-reliability constraints.
Do not treat a quantum-sampling result as a universal computational-speed result.
Do not report observed experimental results or a universal numerical ceiling.
